description: Check every version a WordPress site runs: the core version and its plugins and themes, as {slug, version} lists or the raw output of wp plugin list and wp theme list (table, CSV or JSON). Returns, most urgent first, which installed versions are affected, by which entries, and what to update to. Plugins with no public records are reported as not in the catalog. Nothing is fetched from the site.

core.description: The WordPress version, such as 6.8.3 (wp core version).

plugins.description: Plugins as [{"slug", "version"}], or WP-CLI output or one "slug version" per line as a string.

themes.description: Themes, in the same forms as plugins.

name: check_wordpress

unknown.description: Plugins and themes no entry names.

title: Check a WordPress site
